transcript.user: Is my card still safe to use meanwhile?
transcript.answer:
I can't confirm whether your card is safe. Nothing in your account data shows a compromise, and a duplicate charge from a merchant doesn't by itself mean your card details have been stolen. I can't block cards with my tools.

Under Verta's security policy, you can block your card immediately if you're worried about it. A block can be reversed within 30 days. After that, a replacement card has to be ordered. A block also generates a security notification.

If you want to block the card, or need help doing so, I can escalate this to a human agent. Would you like me to do that?
